# Krazic

> Free browser games with zero downloads. Play car parking, fruit slicing, hill racing, and sky island games instantly in your browser.

Krazic is an arcade site for quick, mobile-friendly HTML5 games. No installs and no sign-ups required.

## Pages

- [Home](https://krazic.com/): Browse the full game lineup
- [Precision Car Parking 3D](https://krazic.com/precision-car-parking-3d/): Park in tight city spots
- [Neon Fruit Cutter](https://krazic.com/fruit-cutter-game/): Slice fruit, chain combos, avoid bombs
- [Mountain Climb Rally](https://krazic.com/mountain-climb-rally/): Race over hills and gaps
- [Cloud Hop 3D](https://krazic.com/cloud-hop-3d/): Hop across floating sky islands

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://krazic.com/sitemap.xml)
